purpose: Initial diagnostic corpus; not held-out evidence of superiority.

cases.rationale: A local null pointer reaches the unconditional dereference without a write or guard.
The early return prevents the null local from reaching the dereference.
The available callee unconditionally returns null and the caller directly dereferences it.
The callee returns the address of a live static object; no nullable alternative exists in this fixture.
Reassigning p does not change the null value previously copied to q.
The dereferenced pointer is reassigned to a live local before use.
Built-in logical AND short circuits, so the null pointer is not dereferenced.
The external return contract is absent; neither nullability nor non-nullness is established.
The assignment after the guard invalidates that guard for the later null dereference.
The expression invokes a defined member operator on a live object, not a raw-pointer dereference.
